data.name: My Bloody Weekend 3
data.detailed_description:
The Cult of the Ancients is back, and they're here for their most vital mission yet. Every brother needs to sharpen their best tool and join the action: Big cult means BIG TROUBLE!

My Bloody Weekend 3 is the all-new game experience from Necronomicon Games. Set in a terrifying new location, you'll be thrust into a fight for survival with two distinct protagonists. Discover a brutal new way to survive the massacre, facing an horde of enemies ready to strike when your guard is down.

Channeling classic slasher B-Movie vibes, this title ramps up the action compared to previous chapters, all while keeping the signature FVM-style storytelling.

Sharpen your own fingers—they’ll be your only weapons. Test your reflexes with thrilling, time-based QTEs featuring 3 distinct forms. Increase the challenge with an enhanced difficulty mode, or cooperate with another survivor in a new local co-op mode. Nothing brings people together like slaying supernatural killers.

Can you stop the ritual? Or will you die trying?

Previously on My Bloody Weekend
In the years following the last massacre, countless cult members have fallen at the hands of one of their intended victims. Having survived the events of the second chapter, Nick began a personal crusade against the Cult of the Elders. Armed with forbidden knowledge gained from the Ancient's manual, he tracked the cult and their heinous harvesting plan, saving other designated targets. Their next target is a woman bearing the mark of the Mother Earth. The ritual must be stopped, or this weekend, an Ancient will be brought back to life.

Who's Mother Earth?
The Mother Earth, the ultimate blesser of all that lives, is thus chronicled within the Tome of the Ancient:

"First amongst her Kind, She doth embrace the Life-power Itself. Releasing periodically an high spiritual energy upon the mortal world, She doth select and mark a Woman to seal this power within her flesh. The Marked, by decree, shall see their mortal abilities and reflexes heightened, causing them to excel far beyond the common human standard. Should the Marked perish, an insurmountable peak of spiritual energy shall be loosed upon the world, which no living mortal soul may then embrace."

Who's the Leach King?
The Lich King serves as the primary leader of the Cult in the modern era. Having died once, he was returned to life by the darkest magic, granting him unnatural powers. The Tome of the Ancient describes him thus:

"In every age, the Lich King shall ever lead the Cult in its most fruitful mission. Freed from the rotten flesh that doth ensnare our true power, the Lich King is blessed by the Ancients with clearer vision into the destiny of the world. The Lich King shall never truly perish: for when a new King is decreed, his spirit and mind shall bond with his Ancestors. Only the most faithful and ruthless members may inherit this sacred mantle. He shall then discern the Moon's phases and the turning of the Ages, that he may best organize the most profitable Harvest strategy."

data.short_description: The MBW franchise returns! My Bloody Weekend 3 is a terrifying, Quick-Time-style experience featuring new protagonists, relentless enemies, and brand-new difficulty/co-op modes. Get ready for the bloodiest live-action harvest yet!

content_descriptors.notes: The game is about killings. Blood is present in every "game over" scene and even in the beginining menu. Violence, phisical threats, stabbing and slicing is present for the entirety of the game.
